title: OutputFilterCapabilitiesResponse
description: Response for GET /api/outputs/:id/filter-capabilities (HEL-1188). For every column present in the Output's declared schema with a Structured DataFieldType, lists exactly the operators GET /api/outputs/:id/rows's `filter.ops` will currently accept for that column: `contains` always; `gte`/`lte` for integer/float/timestamp columns; `eq`/`in` only when the column's actual distinct-value count in this Output's own node_snapshots data is at or below the capability contract's cardinality bound (see openspec/specs/output-routes-api/spec.md). A column absent from the schema, or present with a Content-category type (string-body/binary-ref), never appears in this response. Two Outputs sharing identical column types MAY report different operators for the same column name when their underlying data's cardinality differs -- this contract is derived from the Output's own data, never from column type alone.

columns.description: One entry per eligible column -- a column with no eligible operators at all is omitted from this array entirely, never listed with an empty `operators` array.
